what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in effect for fiscal 1998?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1997 annual town report does not print the schedule: its Textract text (lines.tsv, every page; 97 of 100 pages carry words; pp4, 98 and 99 carry none) was searched for salary schedule, classification plan, step and grade, and returned only Article 30 of the May 10, 1997 town meeting (p80), which substitutes `the Classification & Salary Schedule proposed by the Personnel Board and appearing in the Report of the Finance Committee, such action to be effective July 1, 1997` -- the schedule itself is in that report, not this one (the index p3: `Finance Committee -see separate pamphlet`) (sources/data/report-tables/1997/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the May 10, 1997 Annual Town Meeting, which carries the Classification & Salary Schedule adopted under Article 30.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1997, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1997 annual town report prints no Inspector of Weights & Measures report: its Textract text (lines.tsv, every page; 97 of 100 pages carry words; pp4, 98 and 99 carry none) was searched for weights, sealer and sealing and returned only the appointment (p9), the receipts line SEALING FEES $851.00 (p46), the appropriation line (p52) and the omnibus line WEIGHTS/MEASURES (p82) (sources/data/report-tables/1997/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1997 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's FY1998 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1997 annual town report prints the FY1998 plan only as a total and as article totals with the items in prose: the Capital Planning report (p12) gives $381,420.00 for the plan and names the items without costs, and Articles 35 ($15,000.00), 36 ($54,030.00) and 37 ($248,220.00) of the May 10, 1997 town meeting (p82) list their items with one amount per article (sources/data/report-tables/1997/). — closes: the Capital Planning Committee's FY1998 Capital Plan as presented to the May 10, 1997 Annual Town Meeting.

what: What did each open capital project article have appropriated, spent and left at 30 June 1997?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds the capital project fund by article from the 2001 and 2010 reports. The 1997 annual town report prints no capital project fund schedule: its Textract text (lines.tsv, every page; 97 of 100 pages carry words; pp4, 98 and 99 carry none) was searched for capital project and capital projects and found only the CAPITAL PROJECT FUND column of the combined balance sheet (p45: cash $362,198.54, bonds payable $210,000.00, undesignated $152,198.54) and the Capital Planning report's plan-level sums for FY95-FY97 (p12) (sources/data/report-tables/1997/). — closes: the Town Accountant's capital project fund detail by article for fiscal 1997.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 1997 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 1997 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (p64) and a repayment schedule (p65) with no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: its Textract text (lines.tsv, every page; 97 of 100 pages carry words; pp4, 98 and 99 carry none) was searched for debt limit, outstanding debt and long-term indebtedness and returned nothing (sources/data/report-tables/1997/). — closes: the Town's FY1997 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.

what: How much new growth did Lunenburg's levy gain in fiscal 1997?
why: `report-valuation` holds new growth (added valuation, new revenue) from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1997 annual town report's Assessors' tables (p44) print valuation, levy, a 1991-1995 history and exemptions and abatements, but no new growth, overlay account or abstract by class code: its Textract text (lines.tsv, every page; 97 of 100 pages carry words; pp4, 98 and 99 carry none) was searched for growth and added valuation and returned only zoning (Phased Growth, pp24, 77-79) (sources/data/report-tables/1997/). — closes: the Assessors' fiscal 1997 tax recapitulation (DOR Form LA-13, new growth).

what: What did each Lunenburg town (non-school) employee earn in the period the 1997 report covers?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings. The 1997 annual town report's TOWN EMPLOYEES / REPORT OF WAGES PAID list is incomplete in our copy: PDF page 97 runs from AHO to GENDRON (read `ENDRON`) with the bottom of the page clipped, pages 98-99 are blank scans, no town total is printed, and the report's own index (p3: `Wages 86-92`) ends at folio 92, which is the last page of the SCHOOL list (PDF p96 prints `92`). 52 town employees are read; the rest are not in the document we hold, and the list prints no year (sources/data/report-tables/1997/). — closes: a complete copy of the 1997 Annual Town Report (Town Clerk), or the Town's 1997 payroll register by employee.
